blocks.text: The Marcos administration’s net satisfaction rating dropped by 5 points from +1 in June to -4 in September 2026, but this remained within the “neutral” range, according to the latest Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey released Friday. This was the second-lowest rating of President Marcos’ administration following its record-low “poor” rating in March 2026. READ:
